source_of_truth: one versioned production manifest per video job
ownership_rules: Every scene and artifact has one owner; collaborators reference its stable ID instead of recreating it.
The background, shared motifs, and core diagram are owned by the assigned scene renderer; overlay and narration tasks consume the registered artifact.
No worker may write outside the output artifacts listed in its task.
All workers read the same manifest revision before starting and must report the revision they used.
A manifest update invalidates only downstream tasks that depend on changed artifact IDs, not the whole project.
No task is complete without a concrete artifact reference or a verifiable failure reason.
Renderer adapters are selected per scene: Motion Canvas for general 2D motion design, Manim for math/science geometry, Blender for selected 3D scenes.
The compositor assembles scene outputs; it must not silently replace a failed scene with static filler cards.
The critic inspects the rendered output and attaches frame/time-specific defects; prompt compliance alone is not quality evidence.

agent_roles.responsibility: Own the brief, visual system, storyboard, scene boundaries, continuity, and task dependencies.
Produce focused query variants per visual beat and provide provenance/licence metadata for candidate assets.
Create or import registered assets; reuse existing IDs when the visual asset already exists.
Own mathematical/scientific scenes, equations, vectors, graphs, and diagram components assigned in the manifest.
Own general 2D typography, editorial motion, compositing within scenes, and transitions assigned in the manifest.
Own only scenes that actually need 3D geometry/camera/materials.
Implement bounded scene code against renderer adapters and tested components; never rewrite unrelated project code per video.
Assemble approved scene outputs and audio without recreating their visual content.
Inspect actual rendered frames and sound checks; request targeted repairs against defects.

current_runtime_truth.note: The authenticated production plan/status/task-update API now uses one persisted manifest for scenes, tasks, dependencies and artifact ownership. Task handoffs require matching manifest revisions, dependencies to succeed first, and outputs to match exclusive ownership. Reported artifacts remain unverified; separate specialist dispatch and independent final visual QA are not implemented by this checkpoint.
